description:
Project Overview

The ORCRIST project at Wageningen develops faster, accurate three-dimensional radiation calculations for clouds and wildfire plumes. The PhD links atmospheric physics, GPU computing and machine learning.

Research Position Overview

Develop Monte Carlo ray-tracing methods for thermal radiation and work with MicroHH simulations. Benchmark approaches relevant to solar forecasting, tropical climate and wildfire plumes, collaborating with a Leiden doctoral researcher on machine-learning denoising.

Research Areas

  • Atmospheric radiation
  • GPU simulation
  • Wildfire plumes
  • Ray tracing
